using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
using Moq;
using Volo.Abp.Cli.Args;
using Volo.Abp.Cli.Commands;
using Xunit;

namespace Volo.Abp.Cli.Commands.Tests;

public class ProjectCreationCommandBaseTests
{
    private readonly Mock<ILogger<NewCommand>> _mockLogger;

    public ProjectCreationCommandBaseTests()
    {
        _mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<NewCommand>>();
    }

    [Fact]
    public async void GetProjectBuildArgsAsync_ShouldLogVersion_WhenVersionOptionIsPresent()
    {
        // Arrange
        var commandLineArgs = new CommandLineArgs(new Dictionary<string, string>
        {
            { "--version", "7.0.0" }
        });
        
        var mockDependencies = CreateMockDependencies(_mockLogger.Object);
        var commandBase = new TestableProjectCreationCommandBase(mockDependencies, _mockLogger.Object);

        // Act
        await commandBase.GetProjectBuildArgsAsync(commandLineArgs, "app", "TestProject");

        // Assert
        _mockLogger.Verify(
            x => x.Log(
                LogLevel.Information,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>(msg => msg.ToString().Contains("Version: 7.0.0")),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat<string>, Exception?, string>>()),
            Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async void GetProjectBuildArgsAsync_ShouldNotLogVersion_WhenVersionOptionIsNotPresent()
    {
        // Arrange
        var commandLineArgs = new CommandLineArgs(new Dictionary<string, string>());
        
        var mockDependencies = CreateMockDependencies(_mockLogger.Object);
        var commandBase = new TestableProjectCreationCommandBase(mockDependencies, _mockLogger.Object);

        // Act
        await commandBase.GetProjectBuildArgsAsync(commandLineArgs, "app", "TestProject");

        // Assert
        _mockLogger.Verify(
            x => x.Log(
                LogLevel.Information,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>(msg => msg.ToString().Contains("Version:")),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat<string>, Exception?, string>>()),
            Times.Never);
    }

    private Dictionary<string, object> CreateMockDependencies(ILogger<NewCommand> logger)
    {
        return new Dictionary<string, object>
        {
            { nameof(ProjectCreationCommandBase.ConnectionStringProvider), new Mock<ConnectionStringProvider>().Object },
            { nameof(ProjectCreationCommandBase.SolutionPackageVersionFinder), new Mock<SolutionPackageVersionFinder>().Object },
            { nameof(ProjectCreationCommandBase.CmdHelper), new Mock<ICmdHelper>().Object },
            { nameof(ProjectCreationCommandBase.InstallLibsService), new Mock<IInstallLibsService>().Object },
            { nameof(ProjectCreationCommandBase.CliService), new Mock<CliService>().Object },
            { nameof(ProjectCreationCommandBase.AngularPwaSupportAdder), new Mock<AngularPwaSupportAdder>().Object },
            { nameof(ProjectCreationCommandBase.InitialMigrationCreator), new Mock<InitialMigrationCreator>().Object },
            { nameof(ProjectCreationCommandBase.EventBus), new Mock<ILocalEventBus>().Object },
            { nameof(ProjectCreationCommandBase.ThemePackageAdder), new Mock<ThemePackageAdder>().Object },
            { nameof(ProjectCreationCommandBase.AngularThemeConfigurer), new Mock<AngularThemeConfigurer>().Object },
            { nameof(ProjectCreationCommandBase.CliVersionService), new Mock<CliVersionService>().Object }
        };
    }

    // Testable subclass to access protected method
    private class TestableProjectCreationCommandBase : ProjectCreationCommandBase
    {
        public TestableProjectCreationCommandBase(
            Dictionary<string, object> dependencies,
            ILogger<NewCommand> logger) 
            : base(
                (ConnectionStringProvider)dependencies[nameof(ProjectCreationCommandBase.ConnectionStringProvider)],
                (SolutionPackageVersionFinder)dependencies[nameof(ProjectCreationCommandBase.SolutionPackageVersionFinder)],
                (ICmdHelper)dependencies[nameof(ProjectCreationCommandBase.CmdHelper)],
                (IInstallLibsService)dependencies[nameof(ProjectCreationCommandBase.InstallLibsService)],
                (CliService)dependencies[nameof(ProjectCreationCommandBase.CliService)],
                (AngularPwaSupportAdder)dependencies[nameof(ProjectCreationCommandBase.AngularPwaSupportAdder)],
                (InitialMigrationCreator)dependencies[nameof(ProjectCreationCommandBase.InitialMigrationCreator)],
                (ThemePackageAdder)dependencies[nameof(ProjectCreationCommandBase.ThemePackageAdder)],
                (ILocalEventBus)dependencies[nameof(ProjectCreationCommandBase.EventBus)],
                Mock.Of<IBundlingService>(),
                (AngularThemeConfigurer)dependencies[nameof(ProjectCreationCommandBase.AngularThemeConfigurer)],
                (CliVersionService)dependencies[nameof(ProjectCreationCommandBase.CliVersionService)])
        {
            Logger = logger;
        }

        // Override abstract methods with minimal implementations
        protected override DatabaseProvider GetDatabaseProvider(CommandLineArgs commandLineArgs) => DatabaseProvider.NotSpecified;
        protected override string GetConnectionString(CommandLineArgs commandLineArgs) => null;
        protected override DatabaseManagementSystem GetDatabaseManagementSystem(CommandLineArgs commandLineArgs) => DatabaseManagementSystem.NotSpecified;
        protected override UiFramework GetUiFramework(CommandLineArgs commandLineArgs, string template) => UiFramework.NotSpecified;
        protected override MobileApp GetMobilePreference(CommandLineArgs commandLineArgs, string template) => MobileApp.None;
        protected override bool GetCreateSolutionFolderPreference(CommandLineArgs commandLineArgs) => false;
    }
}
